title: The regenerate lack none of these
source_text: XXIV. Horum omnium respectu nihil deest obedientiae eorum qui vere pii & per spiritum Dei regeniti sunt. Nec enim corpore tantum Deo serviunt, sed mentem & affectus voluntati ejus subjiciunt. Nec solum opere praestant quae lege praecipiuntur; sed etiam in eo gloriam Dei spectant, & amore illius moventur. Non his, aut illis mandatis duntaxat obedire satagunt; sed universae legi Dei & singulis ejus mandatis sese conformare nituntur. Nec solum ad aliquod tempus, & quandiu res prospere fluunt, sed etiam quum ingruunt tentationes & persecutiones, & ad ultimum usque vitae spiritum mandata Dei ob oculos habent, & actiones suas ad eorum normam exigunt.
pass_a_gloss: XXIV. In respect of all these nothing is lacking to the obedience of those who are truly godly & reborn by the spirit of God. For they do not serve God with the body only, but subject the mind & affections to his will. Nor do they only perform in work what is commanded in the law; but also in it they look to the glory of God, & are moved by love for him. They do not take care to obey merely these, or those commandments; but strive to conform themselves to the whole law of God & to each of its commandments. Nor only for some time, & so long as things flow prosperously, but also when temptations & persecutions rush upon them, & right up to the last breath of life they have the commandments of God before their eyes, & regulate their actions to their rule.
pass_b_english: Thesis XXIV. On all these counts, the obedience of the truly godly, those reborn by God's Spirit, lacks nothing. They serve God not with the body alone but bring mind and affections under his will. They not only do in deed what the law commands; in doing it they aim at God's glory and are moved by love for him.

Their concern is not to obey merely this or that commandment; they try to conform themselves to God's whole law and to every one of its commandments. And they do so not merely for a while, as long as things go well, but also when temptations and persecutions break upon them: to their last breath they keep God's commandments before their eyes and measure their actions by that rule.

lemmas.gloss: reborn by the spirit of God
so long as things flow prosperously
right up to the last breath of life

choices.why: The marks of the obedience Le Blanc grants to believers, which Scripture calls 'perfect' in the sense of integrity.
